chunks: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-'Attar (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd b. 'Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Jabbar narrated to me. He said: Al-Hasan b. 'Ali b. Abi Hamza narrated to me from his father from Abu Basir. He said: I said to Abi 'Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him):

What was the supplication of Yusuf (peace be upon him) in the pit, for we have disagreed regarding it? So he said: When Yusuf (peace be upon him) was in the pit and despaired of life, he said: 'O Allah! If the mistakes and sins have worn out my face before You, and You will not raise a voice from me to You, and You will not answer a supplication for me, then I ask You by the right of the elder Ya'qub. Have mercy on his weakness, and unite me with him, for You know his tenderness toward me and my longing for him.'

He said: Then Abu 'Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) wept. Then he said: And I say: 'O Allah! If the mistakes and sins have worn out my face before You, and You will not raise a voice from me to You, then I ask You by You, for there is nothing like You; and I turn to You through Muhammad, Your Prophet, the Prophet of Mercy. O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah.'
He said: Then Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Say this, and increase in it, for I often say it at great calamities.

key_terms.أخلقت وجهي: Worn out my face/standing — an expression meaning sins have diminished one's honor before God
key_terms.الجب: The pit/well into which Prophet Yusuf was thrown by his brothers (Quran 12:15)
key_terms.الكرب العظام: The great calamities — severe afflictions and distresses
key_terms.بحق الشيخ يعقوب: By the right of the elder Ya'qub — a form of tawassul (seeking intercession) through a prophet
key_terms.نبي الرحمة: The Prophet of Mercy — a title for Prophet Muhammad (S)

ai.seo_question: What was the supplication of Prophet Yusuf in the well according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Abu Basir asks Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about the supplication of Prophet Yusuf (AS) when he was thrown into the well by his brothers and despaired of life. The Imam narrates Yusuf's heartfelt prayer, in which he asks God by the right of his aged father Ya'qub to reunite them. Then the Imam weeps and shares his own adapted version of the supplication, replacing the invocation by Ya'qub's right with a direct appeal to God Himself and intercession through Prophet Muhammad (S), ending with the repeated invocation 'Ya Allah.' The Imam recommends his companions to recite this frequently during great hardships.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
